pages.title: Rupee hits record low, rebounds on RBI intervention

facts.text: ⚠ All-time low: ₹89.41 per USD on 21 Nov 2025; rebounded to ₹89.22–89.23 (24–25 Nov)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Expected band: ₹88.9–₹90.2
facts.head: News

facts.text: India–US trade deal uncertainty
facts.head: Causes

facts.text: Record goods trade deficit: ~USD 42 bn (October); exports fell ~12%; imports record ~USD 76 bn (gold)
facts.head: Causes

facts.text: FPI selling; Japanese yen carry-trade unwind
facts.head: Causes

facts.text: RBI extended export proceeds realisation from 9 to 15 months
facts.head: Causes

facts.text: Forex reserves: ~USD 690 bn
facts.head: RBI support

facts.text: Net spot sales (Jan–Sep 2025): ~USD 20.1 bn; forward sales USD 53.4 bn (Aug) → 59.4 bn (Sep)
facts.head: RBI support

facts.text: ⚠ RBI does not target a level — only curbs volatility (managed float)
facts.head: RBI support

facts.text: Term: NEER; Meaning: Rupee vs basket, no inflation adjustment — rise = appreciation
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Term: REER; Meaning: Inflation-adjusted — ⚠ rise = loss of competitiveness
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Term: Trade deficit; Meaning: Goods imports – exports only
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Term: CAD; Meaning: Goods + services + income + transfers
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Forex reserve components: FCA (largest), Gold, SDRs, Reserve Tranche Position; held by RBI, owned by GoI
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Ministry: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
facts.head: News

facts.text: Replaces: Seeds Act, 1966 and Seeds (Control) Order, 1983
facts.head: News

facts.text: Registration: no seed sold without VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use)-based registration; varieties notified under 1966 Act deemed registered; existing varieties get 3-year provisional registration
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Farmers' rights: may save, use, resow, exchange, sell farm-saved seeds — ⚠ but not under a brand name
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Quality: Centre notifies germination, purity, seed-health standards; mandatory QR code labelling
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Traceability: mandatory onboarding on SATHI Portal
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Central Accreditation System: multi-state firms "deemed registered"
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Imports: quarantine + Indian Minimum Seed Certification Standards; unregistered varieties only for research/trials
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Price control: during scarcity, hoarding, monopoly
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Offence: Trivial; Penalty: Warning + small fine
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Offence: Minor; Penalty: up to ₹2 lakh
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Offence: Major (e.g. spurious/unregistered seeds); Penalty: up to ₹30 lakh, cancellation or imprisonment
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Community seed banks, FPOs, women collectives treated as commercial units; foreign entities can do VCU testing (GM seed risk)
facts.head: Concerns
